preconditions.description: The length of s_1 must be between 1 and 100.
The length of s_2 must be between 1 and 100.
The length of virus must be between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ' for c in s_1)
preconditions.description: All characters in s_1 must be uppercase English letters.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ' for c in s_2)
preconditions.description: All characters in s_2 must be uppercase English letters.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ' for c in virus)
preconditions.description: All characters in virus must be uppercase English letters.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '0' or (len(stdout) > 0 and all(c in 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ' for c in stdout))
postconditions.description: The output must be either '0' or a non-empty string of uppercase English letters.
The output must not contain the virus as a substring.

postconditions.expression: all(any(stdout[i] == s_1[j] and stdout[i] == s_2[k] for k in range(len(s_2))) for i in range(len(stdout)) for j in range(len(s_1)))
postconditions.description: The output must be a subsequence of both s_1 and s_2.
